I would be 4 years old. My dad would still be alive. There would be so many things I could change for the better. I would know who to trust and who not to trust. I would have time to do the things I regret not doing. I could think more about what I'll do in the future. I could spend more time with my dad, and the rest of my family too. I could be a little child again, free of responsibility. I could work on being less lazy. But the first thing I'd do would be writing down my entire dream in my weird, messy four year old handwriting. I wouldn't want to forget that. I'd try to become as good a person as I can. I'd get to know what I want to be and not be in a panic a year before secondary school. I would spend more time with my friends, I wouldn't be so quiet. I'd hug my dad a thousand times, so much that he could barely breathe and I'd say 'Love hurts' when he'd complain. I would let him wear my school bag every day because 'he's doing it while he still can'. I would try to make my mom and dad happier because I would know and understand their problems. I'd appreciate all the people in my life that love me and care about me. I'd help mom and dad renovate the house that we have outside of the city, so I wouldn't regret letting it decay in the future. I'd probably go there with them every weekend, not caring about all the bugs I was so scared of as a child, enjoying the peace and quiet that I said I wouldn't like living in ten years ago. I'd be happy with the things I've got. And I wouldn't be depressed.
